## Unlock more data

What you see on this page is just a glimpse of what Funnel offers. With over 120 Core connectors, we provide the capability to gather data from a wide array of sources. Whether your focus is on social media metrics, e-commerce performance, or advertising ROI, we've got you covered.

We also support more than 10 different data destinations, giving you the flexibility to send your data where it will be most beneficial for your business. From cloud storage solutions to advanced data visualization tools, we facilitate the connections that empower your data-driven decision making.

To discover our complete list of data sources, please visit our [All Data Sources](https://funnel.io/all-data-sources) page. For a comprehensive overview of our data destinations, check out our [All Data Destinations](https://funnel.io/all-data-destinations) page.

## Big picture, granular detail

By connecting to every platform, Funnel helps you gain an omniscient view of your marketing efforts.

![1](https://funnel.io/hubfs/1.svg)

![2](https://funnel.io/hubfs/2.svg)

## More flexibility from custom dimensions and metrics

Standard dimensions and metrics are great, but sometimes you need more. And you’ll get it with our built-in, code-free custom options.
